surface: Private benchmark applications and an external functional readiness controller
xmlDocumentation: The managed executable emits XML; its application types are internal. Rust is a private binary crate, not a public library.

mapping.managed: Kestrel HTTP/TLS -> internal application service -> fixed typed ADO.NET commands -> Npgsql or explicitly pinned SQLite shared library
mapping.directRust: Axum/Hyper/Tokio/rustls HTTP/TLS -> internal Rust application service -> SeaQuery keyset/fixed transaction SQL -> SQLx and pinned SQLite/PostgreSQL
mapping.sharedApplicationSource: Managed route links only accepted BCL canonical/JSON/cursor/filesystem application source and exact schema SQL; it references no NativeWeave assembly
mapping.observation: External real HTTP and independent durable SQL; actual runtime and artifact identity; no metric, replay, or timing substitution

platformScope: Linux x64 only; portable x86-64 compilation. Other filesystem/server profiles are explicitly not implemented in this comparator package.
acceptanceBoundary: Ordinary declared business-workload readiness only. Performance scheduling, B22 correctness/fault/soak dependency, DI/diagnostics/overload applicability and B23 final report remain explicit controller responsibilities.
